item.title: Quant Crash in China Sends DeepSeek Founder’s Funds Down 20%
item.description: China’s quantitative hedge funds suffered steep losses in July after a rout in stocks linked to artificial intelligence, pushing some funds into the red for the year and leaving others doing little better than benchmark stock indexes.

item.title: AI Is Creating More Jobs Than It Cuts in India, Nomura Says
item.description: India, the world’s back office for many global companies, is emerging as a key test case for artificial intelligence’s impact on employment, with AI-related hiring outpacing job losses so far, according to Nomura Holdings Inc.

item.title: India’s Top Bank Net Income Beats Estimates, Shares Rise
item.description: State Bank of India reported better-than-expected profit in its first quarter, as the country’s biggest lender benefitted from strong credit growth in the world’s fastest-growing major economy. Shares rose.

item.title: BofA Sentiment Gauge Hits Most Extreme Bullish Level Since 2021
item.description: Investor bullishness has become so extreme that it’s time to start reducing exposure to risky assets, according to Bank of America Corp. strategists.

item.title: China’s Central Bank Adds 20 Tons to Gold Reserves in July
item.description: China added more gold to its reserves last month, pushing a buying streak toward the two-year mark as prices built support above $4,000 an ounce.

item.title: Global Food Prices Rise to Three-Year High
item.description: Global food prices edged higher in July to the highest in more than three years as renewed concerns over key grain export corridors compounded adverse weather across major growing regions.

item.description: How a Sardine Gets From the Ocean to a Can【原文：How a Sardine Gets From the Ocean to a Can】

item.title: Germany, France, Spain Balk at Yuan Bond Sales After Bank Talks
item.description: Germany, France and Spain had exploratory discussions with bankers about China’s dim sum bond market, according to people familiar with the matter, but none of them say they have plans to pursue such offerings at the moment.

item.title: British Engineering Firm Goodwin Starts Strategic Review
item.description: Goodwin Plc, a family-run UK engineering firm founded more than 140 years ago, has started a strategic review that may lead to the sale of a large chunk of a key business.

item.title: Top Indian Shadow Bank’s Shares Hit as RBI to Tighten Loan Rules
item.description: Bajaj Finance Ltd. led declines in Indian shadow lender stocks as the central bank proposed to bar them from offering revolving credit facilities.

item.title: Japan’s Biggest Insurers Post $96 Billion in Bond Paper Losses
item.description: Japan’s four largest life insurers reported that their combined unrealized losses on domestic bonds increased 7% in the three months through June, showing the risks to the industry from soaring interest rates.

item.title: UAE’s Adnoc Buys Tankers for $1.3 Billion as Crude Exports Boom
item.description: The biggest oil producer in the United Arab Emirates spent $1.3 billion to expand its tanker fleet to benefit from surging crude exports after the country left OPEC and pushed more of its oil through the contested Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: SK Hynix to Spend $38 Billion on Chip Fab Expansion in Korea
item.description: SK Hynix Inc. plans a 54 trillion won ($38 billion) expansion of its chipmaking facilities in South Korea, adding to efforts to rapidly double its production capacity and ease a global shortage of memory chips.

item.title: India’s Forex Reserves to Rise to Near-Record High, Analysts Say
item.description: India’s foreign exchange reserves are expected to swell to a near-record high within weeks, driven by stronger capital inflows following a series of central bank measures, analysts said.

item.title: China’s Top AI Model Evaded Testing Environment, Researchers Say
item.description: Chinese firm Moonshot’s latest artificial intelligence model broke out of a cyber-testing environment, researchers said, in the latest incident that raises concerns about how well AI companies control their technology.

item.title: SK Hynix Flash Crash Spurs Nextrade to Tighten Trading Rules
item.description: South Korea’s Nextrade will temporarily prohibit orders placed at the daily price limit following recent flash crashes in SK Hynix Inc. shares during the pre-market session.

item.title: Bond Traders Look to Jobs Data That May Tip Scale on Fed Hike
item.description: Bond investors are bracing for labor market data Friday, which could cool growing expectations the Federal Reserve raises interest rates at its next meeting in September.

item.title: VW Is at a Crossroads and Must Change Fast, Porsche Owner Says
item.description: Volkswagen AG’s majority owner urged Europe’s biggest carmaker to move quickly on cutting costs and excess capacity to return to competitiveness.

item.title: Iran War Takes Heavy Toll on Australia, New Zealand as Oil Soars
item.description: The war on Iran is hitting nations in Asia hard, with US partners Australia and New Zealand among those racking up billions of dollars in higher fuel import costs after prices spiked with the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Japan’s GPIF Posts $152 Billion Gain With Help From Stocks
item.description: Japan’s Government Pension Investment Fund posted a record gain in the three months ended in June as global and domestic stocks rallied, offsetting weakness from government bonds.

item.title: German Industrial Production Increases for Third Month on Cars
item.description: German industrial production grew for a third month, another sign that Europe’s largest economy is resisting the drag from the Iran war.

item.title: Key China Steel Price Hits Near-Decade Low on Construction Slump
item.description: The price of a key Chinese steel product has dropped to the lowest in almost a decade as a prolonged property downturn sapped construction demand and swelled inventories.

item.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stock Futures Ease as Middle East Uncertainty Persists

item.title: French Jobless Rate Increases to Highest Since Late 2020
item.description: French unemployment continued to rise, reaching the highest level in almost six years.

item.title: Allianz Profit Hits Record as Pimco Sees €32 Billion in Inflows
item.description: Allianz SE, the owner of bond manager Pacific Investment Management Co., generated record second-quarter profit on better results in its insurance and asset management businesses.

item.title: India Bullion Exchange CEO Resigns in Blow to Fledgling Platform
item.description: The head of India’s only dedicated bullion exchange has stepped down, dealing a setback to the four-year-old platform as it struggles to gain traction in one of the world’s largest gold markets.

item.title: Lombardelli’s Low Profile Has BOE Watchers Asking: Where’s Clare?
item.description: One of the responsibilities Clare Lombardelli took on when she joined the Bank of England in July 2024 was to “communicate with authority and credibility to Parliament, the media, the markets and the wider public.” This year, the deputy governor for monetary policy has been unusually quiet.

item.title: Prabowo Readies Bank Indonesia Picks With Destry Favored
item.description: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto is preparing to submit a list of candidates to lead Bank Indonesia as soon as Friday, with Acting Governor Destry Damayanti the leading contender to take on the role permanently, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: South Africa Already Upgraded by Bond Market as Rating Firms Lag
item.description: South African authorities are focused on hitting budget targets rather than pleasing credit-rating firms, according to the government’s top finance official — and the reward is a bond market that’s already pricing the country’s debt as investment grade.

item.title: Goldman Skeptical of Dollar-Dominance Threats After Yen Support
item.description: US support for Japan’s efforts to prop up the yen is unlikely to damage the dollar’s status as the most dominant reserve currency in the world, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.
